reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper that the schedule preview, forecast and template code already use.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-implemented; the handler only spreads the existing external model and adds one field.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list type in api-models.ts; putting it in the handler rather than scheduleModel.toExternal is reasonable since only the list exposes it.

scope.why: Handler, type, a focused test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A small, typed extension whose rule stays in the one shared helper, so future changes to the amount rule flow through automatically.
